description: This file defines a thread-safe generic object pool implementation using the Microsoft.Extensions.ObjectPool framework, with specific classes for concurrent object pooling with custom policies.

classes.name: ConcurrentObjectPool<T>
classes.description: A concurrent object pool class that inherits from a generic base class with default policy, enabling reuse of objects in multithreaded scenarios.

classes.name: ConcurrentObjectPool<T, TPoolPolicy>
classes.description: A generic class implementing a thread-safe object pool with customizable policy for object creation and return actions.

methods.name: ConcurrentObjectPool()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the base class with a new default policy.

methods.name: ConcurrentObjectPool(TPoolPolicy policy)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a custom pool policy.

methods.name: Get()
methods.description: Retrieves an object from the pool, creating a new one if the pool is empty.

methods.name: Return(T obj)
methods.description: Returns an object to the pool if eligible according to the policy and pool size constraints.
